text:
IncBot: :rotating_light: ALERT P1: multiple containers in inference-runtime-prod crashlooping on pool-prod-3 (segfault). Paging oncall.
Ryan (oncall): I'm on it, looking at the cluster now. Which service is throwing segfaults?
Alice: seeing repeated restarts from `inference-runtime:v1.4.2` on node gpu-03. Crash reason in kube events: `OOMKilled` then `Signal 11 (Segmentation fault)` in runtime-engine.
Sanjay: attaching recent logs from pod inference-runtime-5f7d9:
```
[2026-03-15T20:03:12Z] runtime: CUDA error 77 (an illegal memory access was encountered)
[2026-03-15T20:03:12Z] backtrace: fused_kernel_forward() +0x1a3
[2026-03-15T20:03:12Z] signal: segmentation fault (11)
```
Ryan (oncall): looks like a fused-kernel path in the custom CUDA op. Could be a bad kernel or corrupted KV cache size. Are customers reporting errors?
Support: yes, we have a cluster of 3 customer tickets showing model completions failing with 500s since ~20:02 UTC. Approx 4% of hosted API requests to that model are failing. Customer IDs: C-4721, C-9982, C-1104. Escalated to priority.
Maya: any node flaps? I see gcloud alerts: node gpu-03 briefly NotReady at 20:04 then back at 20:05.
Infra-Bot: Node gpu-03 events:
- 20:03:55 kubelet: Eviction threshold reached, killing pods
- 20:04:03 kernel: GPU fault on device 0
- 20:04:12 docker: container exit code 139

Alice: core dumps present at /var/crash/inference-runtime-5f7d9.core. gdb backtrace points at `trt_fused_attention.cu` lines.
Ryan (oncall): immediate mitigation steps from runbook: 1) scale down replicas for model pool to 0 on pool-prod-3, 2) cordon node gpu-03, 3) route traffic to pool-prod-1/2, 4) fallback to quantized-model-v2 if needed. I'll start those.
Sanjay: running commands now:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment model-pool-prod --replicas=0 --selector=node=gpu-03
kubectl cordon gpu-03
kubectl rollout restart deployment model-router --namespace inference
```
Ryan (oncall): scaled down pods on gpu-03, cordoned node, routing updated. Noticed a surge in memory usage on pool-prod-3 before the crash — possibly memory leak + driver bug.
Maya: I'll trigger a rolling restart of the runtime daemonset on other nodes to flush caches: `kubectl rollout restart ds/inference-runtime -n inference`.
Carol: adding: TensorRT variant was recently promoted to v1.4.2 runtime build. Can we roll back to v1.4.1 on the affected pool as a short-term fix?
Alice: I can push an image rollback for pool-prod-3 to v1.4.1 and re-enable replicas behind a canary traffic policy.
Ryan (oncall): go ahead with rollback as canary after cordon is lifted and we reprovision a clean node in pool-prod-4.
Support: customers updated: incident acknowledged, we have ETA 30-60m for mitigation; linking customer-facing stub.
IncBot: Severity: P1, Incident link: https://infra.redwood/incidents/2402109876 (auto-created)
Sanjay: while we coordinate, here's a minimal gdb snippet to inspect core:
```
(gdb) bt
#0  0x00007f8a2b0c1e7f in trt_fused_attention::compute() at trt_fused_attention.cu:412
#1  0x00007f8a2b1a3cda in vllm::forward() at vllm.cpp:1289
```
Ryan (oncall): probable cause: kernel not checking for out-of-bounds when sequence length spikes. We'll add bounds checks in fused kernel in next patch. For now, rollback/patch combo.
Maya: repro environment spun up on staging; I can reproduce segfault with long contexts using quantized-model-v3 + runtime v1.4.2. v1.4.1 + quantized-model-v3 doesn't crash.
Carol: rolling rollback to v1.4.1 on a single node pool-prod-4 and will run canary traffic 10%.
Alice: canary looks stable for 6 minutes, no segfaults, memory stable. Increasing traffic to 50%.
Ryan (oncall): good. cordon remains on gpu-03 for deeper hardware/kernel analysis. Opening a follow-up incident for hardware team.
Support: updating customers: mitigation in progress, reduced error rate to ~0.5%. Sending customer note.
IncBot: next oncall rotation reminder: handoff to Maya in 32 minutes. Current oncall: Ryan. Handoff required if incident extends past window.
Ryan (oncall): documenting steps taken in postmortem draft and flagging for engineering: 1) rollback v1.4.1 short-term, 2) patch fused kernel to add bounds checks, 3) add e2e test for long context on CI, 4) improve runaway memory instrumentation in runtime.
Maya: I'll pick up hotpatch PR for fused kernel and coordinate QA. Tagging @Sanjay for CUDA kernel review.
Sanjay: ack. I'll also check driver versions across nodes; GPU driver mismatch could surface illegal memory access.
Carol: summary for postmortem: customer impact P1, partial outage for specific model pool on pool-prod-3; mitigated by node cordon and rollback; repro confirmed on v1.4.2; next steps: hotfix, driver audit, improved CI.
Support: closing immediate customer loop with note and offering credits where SLA impacted.
Ryan (oncall): handing off active incident to Maya for remainder of the shift. If anything spikes, page me.
Maya: taking over. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
